map.将文本按 NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD 等范式进行 Unicode 规范化: Normalizes text to Unicode NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD forms, unifying variant characters and combining characters to fix cross-system display and comparison issues.
map.去重前归一：把「é」的多种编码（预组合/分解）统一，避免同一字符被当两条。: Normalize before dedup: unify the multiple encodings of "é" (precomposed/decomposed) so the same character isn't treated as two.
map.搜索匹配：归一后「café」与「café」(不同编码) 才能正确相等。: Search matching: only after normalization do "café" and "café" (different encodings) compare equal.
map.存储统一：入库前用 NFC，保证跨系统一致显示。: Storage consistency: use NFC before storing to ensure consistent display across systems.
map.：「é」可写作预组合 U+00E9 或 e+组合声调 U+0301；NFC 归并: : "é" can be written as precomposed U+00E9 or e + combining acute U+0301; NFC merges to the former, NFD splits to the latter. After normalization the two "café" strings are equal, so dedup and comparison are correct.
map.存储与比对常用 NFC；NFKC 还会兼容等价（如全角转半角、罗马数字转字母），: Storage and comparison usually use NFC; NFKC additionally applies compatibility equivalence (e.g. full-width to half-width, Roman numerals to letters), good for cleaning but potentially meaning-changing, so use it cautiously in display.
map.NFC/NFD 不丢；NFKC 可能把「①」变「1」、全角变半角，改变原意，仅用: NFC/NFD lose nothing; NFKC may turn "①" into "1" and full-width into half-width, changing the original meaning—don't display NFKC results directly when only matching internally.
